mapper.insert: INSERT INTO run (run_id, tenant_id, snapshot_id, idempotency_key, request_digest, state, fencing_token, lease_owner, lease_expires_at, attempt, input_payload, correlation_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{runId}::uuid, #{tenantId}::uuid, #{snapshotId}::uuid, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestDigest}, 'RUNNING'::run_state, #{fencingToken}, #{leaseOwner}, #{leaseExpiresAt}, 0, #{inputPayloadJson}::jsonb, #{correlationId}, now(), now())
INSERT INTO run_event (tenant_id, run_id, sequence_no, event_type, payload) VALUES (#{tenantId}::uuid, #{runId}::uuid, #{sequenceNo}, #{eventType}, #{payloadJson}::jsonb)
mapper.update: UPDATE run SET state = #{state}::run_state, completed_at = #{completedAt}, result_payload = #{resultPayloadJson}::jsonb, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND run_id = #{runId}::uuid AND state = 'RUNNING'::run_state AND fencing_token = #{fencingToken}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO run_step (tenant_id, run_id, step_number, state, step_type, fencing_token, started_at, completed_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}::uuid, #{runId}::uuid, #{stepNumber}, 'RUNNING'::run_state, #{stepType}, #{fencingToken}, #{startedAt}, #{completedAt})
